components.name: Sort action
components.description: Full-width action; enabled hover changes fill, disabled opacity is 0.65. No custom active state.
components.css: .ds-sort { color-scheme: light dark; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: light-dark(#24332e, #e6eee9); width: 100%; min-height: 42px; border-radius: 6px; border: 0; padding: 10px 16px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--accent, light-dark(#23633f, #a7dfb8)); color: var(--on-accent, light-dark(#ffffff, #122d1b)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-sort:hover:not(:disabled) { background: light-dark(#174c2d, #bcecca); } .ds-sort:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: 0.65; } .ds-sort:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, light-dark(#23633f, #a7dfb8)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sort select
components.description: Native select; no custom hover or active treatment.
components.html: <label class="ds-sort-label" for="ds-mode">Sort by</label><select class="ds-select" id="ds-mode"><option>Title · A–Z</option><option>Hostname · A–Z</option></select>
components.css: .ds-sort-label { color-scheme: light dark; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: light-dark(#24332e, #e6eee9); display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-select { color-scheme: light dark; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: light-dark(#24332e, #e6eee9); width: 100%; min-height: 42px; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; background: light-dark(#fff, #233128); border: 1px solid var(--line, light-dark(#bccbc0, #52685a)); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, light-dark(#23633f, #a7dfb8)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hostname grouping
components.description: Native checkbox with supporting hint; disabled label is muted. No custom hover or active state.
components.html: Choose hostname sorting to create groups.
components.css: .ds-checkbox-label { color-scheme: light dark; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: light-dark(#24332e, #e6eee9); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-checkbox { width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent, light-dark(#23633f, #a7dfb8)); } .ds-checkbox-label:has(input:disabled) { color: var(--muted, light-dark(#53665c, #afc2b5)); cursor: default; } .ds-hint { color-scheme: light dark; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: light-dark(#24332e, #e6eee9); margin: 6px 0 0 24px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted, light-dark(#53665c, #afc2b5)); } .ds-checkbox:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, light-dark(#23633f, #a7dfb8)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status feedback
components.description: Empty status hides; normal status inherits text; data-error selects the failure color.
components.css: .ds-status { color-scheme: light dark; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: light-dark(#24332e, #e6eee9); margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 13px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-status:empty { display: none; } .ds-status:not(:empty) { margin-top: 12px; } .ds-status[data-error] { color: light-dark(#9b302a, #ffb4aa); }

narrative.overview: A user-approved compact utility with system typography, plain native controls, OS light/dark theming, and a green accent. This records the shipped implementation, not a new brand direction.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed narrow layout and full-width action.
Flat surfaces, visible keyboard focus, quiet supporting text.
dos: Do retain the 320px popup, 24px inset, and native controls.
Do follow OS light/dark colors and preserve visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't introduce custom fonts, decorative brand requirements, or raster artwork.
Don't replace the flat popup with cards, shadows, or animated controls.
